detail.longDescription: 🦎 openSUSE’s Agama 26 to Support Fully Automated AI-Driven Linux Installations "For example, users could ask an AI assistant to install openSUSE Tumbleweed with GNOME, configure an NVMe drive with Btrfs, and create a user account without manually going through the installer’s configuration screens." https:// linuxiac.com/opensuse-agama-26 -to-support-fully-automated-ai-driven-linux-installations/ # opensuse # ai # distros # opensource
